title: Tsunami speed depends on ocean depth
caption: A tsunami's wavelength is far longer than the ocean is deep, so it travels as a shallow-water wave at v = √(gd). Over 4000 m of ocean that is 198 m s⁻¹ (about 710 km h⁻¹), crossing 3000 km in about 4.2 hours; it slows and grows taller as the water shallows.
alt: Wave speed against ocean depth, a square-root curve, with 198 metres per second at 4000 metres marked.
description: At 10 m depth near the coast: about 10 m s⁻¹.
